source: Original work for Hexfall, except the piece models (see credits). Terrain tiles (tiles/forest|pasture|fields|hills|mountains|desert.webp): AI-generated with Creative Claw (Nano Banana 2) from text prompts only, with no image inputs or reference art, then approved by the project owner on 2026-11-04. The sea is a procedural shader that also samples two seamless textures (water/caustics|sand.webp): AI-generated with the Gemini image API (Nano Banana) from text prompts only (tools/sea-gen.mjs), made seamless by an offset cross-fade, with the owner-supplied reference screenshot used for style guidance only (never uploaded, copied or traced), then approved by the project owner on 2026-11-06. Harbor badges (harbors/brick|grain|lumber|ore|wool.webp): square crops of the resource card art, which is cropped from the terrain tiles by tools/cards-from-tiles.mjs. Piece models (models/road|settlement|city.glb): converted from STL models by Burgers (CC-BY-4.0) with tools/stl-to-glb.mjs, reoriented, rescaled and with a thinned road. The harbor boat model (models/boat.glb): original work by the project owner, made for Hexfall in Blender. The harbor jetty model (models/jetty.glb): original work for Hexfall, generated in Blender by a script and reviewed by the project owner. The coast kit (models/boulder|cliff|wall|bush.glb): original work for Hexfall, generated in Blender by a script (tools/blender/coast-kit.py). The forest trees (models/tree.glb): a mix of original faceted trees (spruces of three sizes, a birch, a broadleaf tree), generated in Blender by a script (tools/blender/forest-trees.py), and the 8 background trees of "Low Poly Forest Tree Pack" by 99.Miles (CC-BY-4.0), downloaded by the project owner and rescaled, re-anchored and given a smaller baked texture by tools/blender/tree-pack.py (see credits). The pasture sheep (models/sheep.glb): original work for Hexfall, generated in Blender by a script (tools/blender/sheep.py). The sheep camp kit (models/camp.glb: shepherd's hut, fence, feed trough, hay pile): original work for Hexfall, generated in Blender by a script (tools/blender/sheep-camp.py), with an owner-supplied concept sheet used for style guidance only. The forest kit (models/woods.glb: fallen log, stump, fern, woodpile, mushrooms): original work for Hexfall, generated in Blender by a script (tools/blender/forest-kit.py), with an owner-supplied low-poly forest reference sheet used for style guidance only. The mountain peaks (models/peak.glb): cut from an owner-supplied landscape model (kept outside the build) and reduced to a cartoon style in Blender by a script (tools/blender/mountain-kit.py). The ore and grey stone clusters (models/ore.glb): original work for Hexfall, generated by the same script, with the ore resource icon used for style guidance only. The sea gulls (models/gull.glb): the animated "Low Poly Bird (Animated)" model (CC-BY-4.0, see credits), supplied by the project owner, then turned, rescaled and given a smaller texture by tools/blender/gull.py. The robber uses its built-in procedural fallback.
